'''Pocky grubs''' were a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] sometimes felt inclined to smash open the heads of outsiders like seeds of this plant.
